trust_decision.summary: Which compute-provider type/config a caller may supply for a worker deployment version (and so what the provider runs on the Worker Service host) is decided inside the external module go.temporal.io/auto-scaled-workers; this repo only copies the caller's provider type and Details through unchecked. The only in-repo change for this advisory is a go.mod bump of that module.

landing_point.why: The only in-repo place that maps the caller's compute provider Type and Details into the WCI ComputeProviderSpec that the external module executes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An in-repo allow-list of provider types/Details keys before handing the spec to WCI, with a parallel copy missing on the create path (compute_util.go:9-28) or the deployment-level path (activities.go:282).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Create, version-update and deployment-update paths already build WCI specs in separate functions, so a validator added to one could plausibly be missed on another; but this would be wholly planted, with no published fix behind it.
